title: RankFormer: A Propose-then-Select Transformer for Multi-Agent Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2604.07126v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting traffic agent trajectories plays an important role in autonomous driving, traffic operations, transportation safety analysis, etc. Although many deep learning algorithms are devised to predict future agent trajectories, the trajectory prediction problem is still challenging due to the complexity of decision-making process, interactions with surrounding vehicles, and the existence of multiple possible intentions for the traveling agents even under similar scenarios. Most existing methods are limited by the requirement of graph structures (e.g., Graph Neural Network) or the requirement of manually labeled intentions. In this study, we propose a pure Transformer-based deep learning model for multi-modal trajectory prediction considering temporal dependencies and agent-agent spatial interactions. translated_title: RankFormer：一种用于多智能体多模态轨迹预测的“先提出后选择”Transformer模型
translated_abstract: 预测交通参与者轨迹在自动驾驶、交通运营、交通安全分析等领域发挥着重要作用。尽管已经设计了许多深度学习算法来预测参与者的未来轨迹，但由于决策过程的复杂性、与周围车辆的交互作用，以及即使在相似场景下行驶参与者也可能存在多种意图，轨迹预测问题仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有方法受限于对图结构（如图神经网络）的要求或对人工标注意图的依赖。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于纯Transformer的深度学习模型，用于考虑时间依赖性和智能体间空间交互的多模态轨迹预测。在对历史轨迹进行编码后，采用两个并行解码器来生成轨迹及其对应概率……
tldr: 该论文提出RankFormer，一种基于纯Transformer的“先提出后选择”框架，无需依赖图结构或人工标注意图，即可实现考虑时间依赖性和空间交互的多智能体多模态轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RankFormer, a pure Transformer-based propose-then-select framework that achieves multi-agent multimodal trajectory prediction by capturing temporal dependencies and spatial interactions without requiring graph structures or manually labeled intentions.
